src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: Wisconsin Legislature, 2011 Wisconsin Act 44 (congressional districts; enacted Aug. 9, 2011)

Eight districts; used for the 2012 through 2020 elections. Superseded for the 2022 general election by the Wisconsin Supreme Court's Johnson II plan. Census check: cb_2020_us_cd116 (CDSESSN 116; lines supplied by the states by May 1, 2018) holds this plan; 6 of 8 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file, as a new plan should.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 Wisconsin Act 43 legislative plan: 33 Senate districts, each made of three Assembly districts
Wisconsin Legislature, 2011 Wisconsin Act 43 (legislative districts; enacted Aug. 9, 2011)

Used for the 2012 through 2020 elections. Senate lines as in Act 43; a three-judge federal court ordered only Assembly Districts 8 and 9 redrawn (Baldus v. GAB, No. 11-CV-562), and whether that touched Senate District 3 was not checked. Census check: cb_2020_us_sldu (LSY 2018, 33 districts; boundaries collected for the 2018 election year) holds this plan, which was unchanged to November 2020; 31 of 33 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file (keys only in the 2020 file: []; only in the 2022 file: ['ZZZ']).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 Wisconsin Act 43 legislative plan: 99 Assembly districts, with Districts 8 and 9 as redrawn by the federal court (Baldus v. GAB, No. 11-CV-562, E.D. Wis.)
Wisconsin Legislature, 2011 Wisconsin Act 43 (legislative districts; enacted Aug. 9, 2011)

Used for the 2012 through 2020 elections. The court-ordered Districts 8 and 9 replaced the Act's versions (Voting Rights Act, Section 2). Census check: cb_2020_us_sldl (LSY 2018, 99 districts; boundaries collected for the 2018 election year) holds this plan, which was unchanged to November 2020; 93 of 99 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file (keys only in the 2020 file: []; only in the 2022 file: ['ZZZ']).
